21838-which-or-between-two-women.title: Which Or Between Two Women
21838-which-or-between-two-women.creator: Unknown
21838-which-or-between-two-women.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. OR, BETWEEN TWO WOMEN," _is the title of a new, very thrilling and intensely interesting novel, by Ernest Daudet, one of the best known and most widely read of the living French novelists. A highly romantic, attractive and touching love story, in which a gypsy girl of great beauty and heroism, named Dolores, and Antoinette de Mirandol, an heiress, are rivals for the possession of Philip de Chamondrin, the hero, forms the main theme, and it is most skilfully and effectively handled.

arxiv-2008-10510.title: Finite-range effects in the two-dimensional repulsive Fermi polaron
arxiv-2008-10510.creator: Raúl Bombín, Viktor Cikojević, Juan Sánchez-Baena, Jordi Boronat
arxiv-2008-10510.description: Abstract We study the repulsive Fermi polaron in a two-component, two-dimensional system of fermionic atoms inspired by the results of a recent experiment with 173 Yb atoms [N. Darkwah Oppong et al. , Phys. Rev. Lett. 122 , 193604 (2019)].

arxiv-2112-01974.title: On Quadratic Gravity
arxiv-2112-01974.creator: John F. Donoghue 1, Gabriel Menezes 2
arxiv-2112-01974.description: Abstract We provide a brief overview of what is known about Quadratic Gravity, which includes terms quadratic in the curvatures in the fundamental action. This is proposed as a renormalizeable UV completion for quantum gravity which continues to use the metric as the fundamental dynamical variable. However, there are unusual field-theoretic consequences because the propagators contain quartic momentum dependence.

arxiv-2211-17087.title: Precession of magnetars: dynamical evolutions and modulations on polarized electromagnetic waves 2022 Precession of magnetars: dynamical evolutions and modulations on polarized electromagnetic waves – A
arxiv-2211-17087.creator: Yong Gao, Lijing Shao, Gregory Desvignes, David Ian Jones, Michael Kramer, Garvin Yim
arxiv-2211-17087.description: Abstract Magnetars are conjectured to be highly magnetized neutron stars (NSs). Strong internal magnetic field and elasticity in the crust may deform the stars and lead to free precession. We study the precession dynamics of triaxially-deformed NSs incorporating the near-field and the far-field electromagnetic torques. We obtain timing residuals for different NS geometries and torques.

arxiv-2301-08841.title: mkite: A distributed computing platform for high-throughput materials simulations Journal: Computational Materials Science
arxiv-2301-08841.creator: Daniel Schwalbe-Koda
arxiv-2301-08841.description: Abstract Advances in high-throughput simulation (HTS) software enabled computational databases and big data to become common resources in materials science. However, while computational power is increasingly larger, software packages orchestrating complex workflows in heterogeneous environments are scarce. This paper introduces mkite, a Python package for performing HTS in distributed computing environments.

arxiv-2303-08739.title: Detecting Nontrilocal Correlations In Triangle Networks
arxiv-2303-08739.creator: Kaushiki Mukherjee
arxiv-2303-08739.description: Abstract Correlations in quantum networks with independent sources exhibit a completely novel form of nonclassicality in the sense that the nonlocality of such correlations can be demonstrated in fixed local input scenarios. Before the pioneering work by M.O.Renou, et al., in gis1 , the nonlocal feature of such network correlations was directly attributable to standard Bell nonlocality.

arxiv-2307-05116.title: Topological interface states – a possible path towards a Landau-level laser in the THz regime
arxiv-2307-05116.creator: Mark O. Goerbig
arxiv-2307-05116.description: Abstract Volkov-Pankratov surface bands arise in smooth topological interfaces, i.e. interfaces between a topological and a trivial insulator, in addition to the chiral surface state imposed by the bulk-surface correspondence of topological materials. These two-dimensional bands become Landau-quantized if a magnetic field is applied perpendicular to the interface.

arxiv-2406-19418.title: A Quantization-based Technique for Privacy Preserving Distributed Learning
arxiv-2406-19418.creator: Maurizio Colombo, Rasool Asal, Ernesto Damiani, Lamees Mahmoud AlQassem, Al Anoud Almemari, Yousof Alhammadi
arxiv-2406-19418.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Maurizio Colombo, Rasool Asal, Ernesto Damiani, Lamees Mahmoud AlQassem, Al Anoud Almemari, Yousof Alhammadi. The massive deployment of Machine Learning (ML) models raises serious concerns about data protection. Privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) offer a promising first step, but hard challenges persist in achieving confidentiality and differential privacy in distributed learning. In this paper, we describe a novel, regulation-compliant data protection technique for the distributed training of ML models, applicable throughout the ML life cycle regardless of the underlying ML architecture.

arxiv-2410-10607.title: Sealed-bid Auctions on Blockchain with Timed Commitment Outsourcing
arxiv-2410-10607.creator: Jichen Li, Yuanchen Brian Tang, Jing Chen, Xiaotie Deng, Bin Xiao
arxiv-2410-10607.description: Abstract Sealed-bid auctions play a crucial role in blockchain ecosystems. Previous works introduced viable blockchain sealed-bid auction protocols, leveraging timed commitments for bid encryption. However, a crucial challenge remains unresolved in these works: Who should bear the cost of decrypting these timed commitments? This work introduces a timed commitment outsourcing market as a solution to this challenge.

arxiv-2503-03938.title: Protocols for inter-module two-qubit gates mediated by time-bin encoded photons
arxiv-2503-03938.creator: Z. M. McIntyre, W. A. Coish
arxiv-2503-03938.description: Abstract As quantum devices scale to larger numbers of qubits, entangling gates between distant stationary qubits will help provide flexible, long-range connectivity in modular architectures. In this work, we present protocols for implementing long-range two-qubit gates mediated by either Fock-state or time-bin qubits—photonic encodings that are both compatible with the coplanar waveguide resonators commonly used in circuit quantum electrodynamics (QED).

arxiv-2505-22902.title: Markovian heat engine boosted by quantum coherence
arxiv-2505-22902.creator: Freddier Cuenca-Montenegro 1, Marcela Herrera 1, John H. Reina 1,2
arxiv-2505-22902.description: Abstract We evaluate the role of quantum coherence as a thermodynamic resource in a noisy, Markovian, one-qubit heat engine. By consuming the coherence of noisy quantum states, we demonstrate that the engine can surpass the classical efficiency limit when operating according to a quantum Otto cycle.

arxiv-2508-00165.title: C 1 C^{1} invariant, stable and inertial manifolds for non-autonomous dynamical systems Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author. Thanks: The work of Piotr Kalita was supported by FAPESP, Brazil grant 2020/14075-6 and Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación of Kingdom of Spain under project No. PID2021-122991NB-C2
arxiv-2508-00165.creator: Radosław Czaja 1, Piotr Kalita 2,∗, Alexandre N. Oliveira-Sousa 3
arxiv-2508-00165.description: Abstract . We use the version of the Lyapunov–Perron method operating on individual solutions to investigate the existence of invariant manifolds for non-autonomous dynamical systems, focusing in particular on inertial and stable manifolds. We establish a characterization of both types of manifolds in terms of solutions exhibiting a common growth behavior, analogous to the classical characterization involving hyperbolicity.

arxiv-2508-07779.title: Hexagonal Picture Scanning Automata
arxiv-2508-07779.creator: Deepalakshmi DAmal Jyothi College of Engineering, Kanjirappally, Kerala, IndiaAPJ Abdul Kalam Technological University,Thiruvananthapuram, India ddeepalakshmi@amaljyothi.ac.in, Lisa MathewAmal Jyothi College of Engineering, Kanjirappally, Kerala, India lisamathew@amaljyothi.ac.in
arxiv-2508-07779.description: Abstract Two new classes of finite automata, called General hexagonal Boustrophedon finite automata and General hexagonal returning finite automata operating on hexagonal grids, are introduced and analyzed. The work establishes the theoretical foundations for these automata models, examines their computational properties, and investigates the relationships and equivalences between the language families they define.

pmc-10737332.title: AGE-ASSOCIATED DECLINE IN TISSUE CIRCADIAN CLOCK FUNCTION
pmc-10737332.creator: Karyn Esser
pmc-10737332.description: Cellular circadian clocks direct a daily transcriptional program that supports homeostasis and resilience. Emerging evidence has demonstrated age-associated changes in circadian functions. To define age-dependent changes at the systems level, we profile the circadian transcriptome in the hypothalamus, lung, heart, kidney, skeletal muscle, and adrenal gland in three age groups.

pmc-12626115.creator: Matouš Vobořil, Shuya Xuan, Kristin A. Hogquist
pmc-12626115.description: Central tolerance in the thymus ensures that the developing T cell repertoire is safe yet effective against infections. This process relies greatly on antigen presentation by both stromal and hematopoietic antigen‐presenting cells (APCs), with dendritic cells (DCs) playing a particularly critical role.
